description: Create custom basketball and other sports court designs with Swish Court Builder. Set dimensions, choose flooring and colors, adjust court markings and borders, and add sports lines, logos, and text. View 2D and 3D previews, download images or videos, and continue editing in Swish Court Builder. Customers can review and order physical court flooring through the Swish Court website.

defaultPrompt: Design a 15 × 11 m single-hoop FIBA court in blue and orange, with white lines. Show it in 3D with an edit link.
Create a pickleball court with green flooring and white lines. Show a 2D preview and the court dimensions.
Design a basketball court with extra tennis lines, my logo, and custom text, then give me a downloadable 2D image.
